occupancy_groups.A2: Other assembly (restaurants, gyms, galleries, worship, schools, libraries, childcare)

rules.text: High-building measures apply when A, D, E or F floors are more than 36 m up, any B storey is above 18 m, B2 or B3 is above the 3rd storey, or residential floors are above 18 m.
No F1 occupancy in a building with any A, B or C occupancy.
Childcare (A2) needs outdoor play: about 14 m2 per child under City guidelines (about 6 m2 provincial licensing); rooftop play is possible if contiguous and sunny.
Each change of occupancy group between floors needs a rated fire separation (typically 1-2 h). Grouping similar uses into bands saves separations.
Neighbouring floors whose activity intensity differs by 3 or more: consider a buffer floor (mechanical, refuge or structural belt).
